votes.motion: To adjourn the Finance Committee meeting
votes.quote: motion by member lockwood to adjourn the finance committee meeting. seconded by member dall. call for the vote: six-aye. the motion passed unanimously (6-0-0).

votes.motion: To adjourn the Select Board meeting
votes.quote: motion by member lehtinen to adjourn the select board meeting at 9:53 p.m. seconded by vice-chair moore. call for the vote: four-aye. the motion passed unanimously (4-0-0).

note: This is a joint meeting of three boards (Select Board, School Committee, Finance Committee). Chair Caesar Nuzzolo of the Select Board was absent (National Guard duty). Member Mike Rupp of Finance Committee was absent. Town Counsel Adam Costa joined remotely via telephone. School Committee Chair Sculimbrene exited before the final public comment period concluded. The minutes note the meeting was recorded and broadcast live over public access channel, Facebook Live, and YouTube.

decisions.decision: All members present supported placing an override on the ballot (non-binding straw poll)
decisions.quote: the moderator called for a straw poll on whether all members present supported placing an override on the ballot. all members present indicated their support. the moderator confirmed that this was unanimous among those in attendance and noted for the record that it was a non-binding straw poll.

decisions.decision: Straw poll on override structure yielded approximately seven members favoring single override number and five favoring two numbers; no binding decision reached
decisions.quote: the moderator then called for a straw poll on the structure of the override: one number, or two numbers. the count yielded approximately seven members in favor of a single override number and five members in favor of two numbers.

decisions.decision: Boards to meet by end of March to finalize override numbers before April 11 ballot language deadline
decisions.quote: the moderator noted that the april 11th ballot language deadline effectively means the tri-board must arrive at a final number by the end of march or very early april

decisions.decision: Chairs to meet to discuss messaging
decisions.quote: moderator murphy suggested that a group get together to work on messaging. a distinction was made between campaigning and messaging. chair menard o

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The District's federal entitlement grants had been cut
budget_items.quote: the school committee had just learned that the district's federal entitlement grants had been cut by approximately $123,000

budget_items.topic: Estimated override impact on household tax bill
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Impact of a $3,000,000 override estimated on average household
budget_items.quote: the estimated impact of a $3,000,000 override on that average household would be an additional $636.27 per year, based on fy26 figures

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Investment income and motor vehicle excise tax revised upward
budget_items.quote: the town manager confirmed that revenues had been revised that same day, with investment income adjusted upward by $100,000 and motor vehicle excise tax by $75,000

budget_items.what_was_recorded: School's restoration budget items identified including staffing positions
budget_items.quote: an interventionist, a kindergarten paraprofessional, a world language teacher, a teacher and paraprofessional for the bridge program, an english teacher, a part-time music teacher, an assistant principal, a literacy coach, and an assistant business manager

public_comment.speaker: Sarah Cammer
public_comment.topic: FY27 budget challenges, school cuts, support for positions, override structure concerns
public_comment.quote: fifty percent of lunenburg students are not meeting literacy targets, and called the school's requests for an interventionist, a kindergarten paraprofessional, a world language teacher, a teacher and paraprofessional for the bridge program, an english teacher, a part-time music teacher, an assistant principal, a literacy coach, and an assistant business manager entirely reasonable and defensible

public_comment.speaker: Sarah Cammer
public_comment.topic: School restoration budget items should not be labeled as optional tier items
public_comment.quote: referring directly to the diagram chair menard had presented earlier, ms. cammer took issue with the labeling of the school's restoration budget items in the highest tier, particularly the items listed as "x, y, z." she identified those items specifically: an english teacher and part-time music teacher to ensure adequate time-on-learning at the high school and middle school, an assistant principal, a literacy coach, and an assistant business manager. "these aren't x, y, z items to me," she stated.

topics.resolution: Structure (single vs. tiered) deferred; binding decision to be reached by end of March/early April before April 11 ballot deadline
topics.quote: the moderator opened the discussion by framing the central question before the tri-board: what form a proposition 2½ override should take, and how it should be structured.
